text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"“if driverless cars were available today, I'd be down for it as long as there was an option”","quality":"clearer stance","description":"The essay states a definite position while also qualifying it, so the reader can tell exactly what the writer supports and under what conditions."},{"evidence":"“I could take naps on long roadtrips… I can't be wasting my moeny on gas”","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay uses concrete, relatable reasons from the article's ideas to back up its position instead of speaking only in generalities."},{"evidence":"“But if the idea of driverless cars isn't executed correctly, it too can kill us.”","quality":"nuanced reasoning","description":"The essay acknowledges both benefits and risks and explains that the outcome depends on how well the technology is developed."},{"evidence":"“However if I as the one in charge were able to choose when the car was driverless”","quality":"logical conditional argument","description":"The essay builds its case through an if-then structure that links safety and convenience to its recommendation."},{"evidence":"“With all that being said, I'm down for driverless cars.”","quality":"coherent conclusion","description":"The ending restates the position and the main conditions clearly, giving the essay a more unified close."}]}
